scope: One native worker; existing diffuse sampling kernels with larger bounded multi-lobe submissions.

versus_fresh.coordinate_convention: PFM rows, bottom first; zero-based pixel coordinates

overhead_units: Fields ending ns or us are converted to seconds; all other fields retain counts/bytes.
overhead_caveats: Scopes overlap and are not additive frame-time costs.
Submit scope includes first-flight initialization; cold setup is not yet isolated.
CUDA-event kernel intervals may include device scheduling/contention; they do not prove pure kernel compute cost.
Transport packing does not include all native packet preparation or replay reconstruction.
CPU request/ticket allocations are visible in source but not separately timed.
Pinned/device slot buffers, streams and events are reused after initialization.

preserved_cancellation_attempt.reason: Harness still expected four chunks after configuration changed to two; stopped before cancellation.

admission_baseline.note: Earlier eight-case single-worker admission check; original probe predates failed-launch accounting correction.

limitations: No broader shader kernel, GPU texture lookup or complete GPU path integration.
Four-lobe cap only exercised with up to two eligible lobes in current fixtures.
No kit installation or default activation.
Before/after activity checks cannot exclude brief competing work between observations.
